subject: Approval request: discretionary uplift + relocation for Sr. Inference Engineer (Evan Roberts)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Approval needed: discretionary uplift + relocation for Sr. Inference Engineer (E. Roberts)

Hi team,

We have an outstanding candidate for Sr. Inference Engineer, Evan Roberts (ref: Greenbridge). He just returned a competing offer that is materially higher on cash comp and includes a guaranteed relocation bonus. Hiring manager and I both think Evan is a strong fit for the inference team and will move the model optimization roadmap forward.

Current standard offer: $220,000 base + 30k annual equity (RSU 4-year) + standard sign-on $10,000.
Competing offer: $250,000 base + $40k equity + $25,000 sign-on/relocation.

Request (exception):
- Increase base to $235,000 (out-of-band uplift)
- One-time relocation/starter stipend: $15,000 (to cover temporary housing & movers)
- Equity refresh / additional grant on signing equivalent to $30,000 (4yr RSU)

Rationale: Evan is already heavily recruited by two competitors and the team has continuous production work that requires senior latency-experience in attention optimizations. Hiring manager will provide a short write-up of the impact.

Attached: candidate comp summary, market bench for remote inference engineers, draft offer letter.

Asks: compensation sign-off (Marcus), finance confirmation on stipend (Laura), Naomi final approval for discretionary uplift before I loop in recruiting to send revised offer.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Engineering Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval needed: discretionary uplift + relocation for Sr. Inference Engineer (E. Roberts)

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) Is the $235k base intended as a permanent comp band adjustment or a one-off offer for Evan?
2) Is the $30k equity an up-front signing grant (additional RSUs) or an accelerated refresh after 12 months?
3) Please confirm total OTE and impact to comp band for the role headcount (we need to track band drift).

If this is a one-off candidate-specific uplift (not a band change), I am inclined to approve given urgency and hard-to-fill skill set, but want explicit confirms from Compensation and Finance. Marcus/Laura, can you weigh in by EOD?

Naomi
Chief People Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 12:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval needed: discretionary uplift + relocation for Sr. Inference Engineer (E. Roberts)

Naomi / Marissa — reviewed the attachments and the market bench. Summary:
- Band: Senior Engineer (Inference) midpoint is $210k base; 90th pctile ~ $235k.
- Proposed $235k base puts us near 90th pctile for remote CA candidates; it is above our typical band but defensible for an exceptional hire.
- Additional $30k equity as signing RSU (vested over 4 years) is acceptable as a one-time sign-on grant; note this will affect rolling equity budget.
- $15k relocation/starter stipend should be treated as a one-time hiring expense (not ongoing comp expense).

Conditions/asks:
- Classify this as a candidate-specific exception (do not change banding).
- Add a clause in the offer that the relocation/starter stipend is contingent on start date within 90 days and is paid in two installments (30/60 days).
- Please confirm there are funds in FY27 hiring reserve; otherwise Finance needs to approve reallocation.

Marcus
Compensation & Rewards
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval needed: discretionary uplift + relocation for Sr. Inference Engineer (E. Roberts)

Naomi / Marissa — finance side: we have limited headroom in the hiring reserve but can cover the one-time $15k relocation stipend and the incremental cash flow impact of the base uplift for Q2 if the role is mission critical. Please note the run-rate increase to comp spend will be ~$180k annually (base uplift x 1 head + prorated on-target comp assumptions).

Approval:
- Finance approves the one-time relocation stipend ($15k)
- Approval for base uplift is conditional on:
  a) candidate starts by 2027-05-31, and
  b) offer includes the stipend repayment clause if candidate leaves within 6 months (pro-rated).

Once Marcus updates the offer draft with the conditional language I will confirm final budget transfer.

Thanks,
Laura
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval needed: discretionary uplift + relocation for Sr. Inference Engineer (E. Roberts)

Thanks all — good alignment. To confirm next steps before Marissa sends the revised offer:
- Marcus: please update offer-letter-draft.docx to reflect candidate-specific exception language, RSU signing grant $30k (4yr), and relocation stipend payment schedule and repayment clause.
- Laura: please process the FY27 hiring reserve transfer once we receive updated language.
- Marissa: send revised offer to Greenbridge / Evan with a clear acceptance window (72 hours) and copy me on the outbound.

Marissa, once you send, please also attach HubSpot HSP-0048721 and create the DocuSign envelope (link in related_links). I'll do a final read of the DocuSign before you send.

If Evan accepts, we'll treat this as a one-off hire exception and schedule a 15-minute retro in 30 days to capture lessons (band drift, market movement).

Naomi
Chief People Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference
